question: Complete the 19 nonunit-residue Artin entries in the fixed 24-ideal experiment using their already exposed prime gcds.
construction: For an unresolved residue gcd p, prove p prime, remove the whole p-power from the ideal norm, evaluate the unit residue by Jacobi on the cofactor, and add the local Frobenius bit at the unique degree-one prime ideal dividing the cyclic ideal, weighted by its valuation. Check the Frobenius bit independently from the retained point signatures.
failure: Unexpected gcd, nonprime gcd, nonunit cofactor residue, ambiguous local prime, failed independent comparison or timeout remains UNKNOWN. Do not add exceptions or enlarge budgets.
claim_boundary: Completes the same retrospective pairing, without selecting new ideals or characters. Full rank, if obtained, certifies the displayed 2-torsion ideal subgroup as a direct factor of the S-class group. It does not bound the remaining class factor or prove unknown covers soluble.
